reproduction_synthetic_hosted_shape.note: one growing journal, 200 symbols, full state line per update, up to 60 closes; append_ms_reparse_previous_behaviour = whole-file parse under exclusive lock (what every append did before)

design.append: in-memory latest state, re-parse only when (inode,size,mtime_ns) differs from last read/write signature
design.compaction: trigger size > max(8MiB, 3x live-line bytes); same inode under existing LOCK_EX; append compacted block, blank old lines at line boundaries, copy block to front, ftruncate; each fsynced step leaves a reader-accepted journal with identical projection (test injects failure at every fsync)

limitations: Other services/source_ingestion tests could not be collected here: fastapi not installed in the available venv (pre-existing, unrelated).
A torn pwrite from power loss inside one 4MiB batch is not covered; process-level interruption is.
